stem.en: A family receives ₹90,000 in a year and decides to save first: it sets aside 20% of the year's income before any spending. How many rupees are left for the family to spend on everything else in that year?

explanation.en: Saving 20% of ₹90,000 means setting aside ₹18,000 on the day the income arrives. The spending then has to fit in ₹90,000 - ₹18,000 = ₹72,000. The savings share is taken from the income, not from whatever happens to be left at the end of the month.

hints.en: Work out 20% of ₹90,000 first. That amount never reaches the spending.
